leadText:
Mr. Shaw (Japanese: ショール Shoal) is a character of the day who appeared in Cilan and the Case of the Purrloin Witness!. He is a businessman and a jewel collector.

Mr. Shaw first came up to Mrs. Ripple's room in a ship cruise and asked her to sell him a rare jewel in her possession, called the "Eye of Liepard". Even though Mrs. Ripple rejected his offer, Shaw still maintained his interest in the jewel, which caused Mrs. Ripple's , the caretaker of the room, to get angry and expel him from the location.

He later took advantage of a power outage caused by a battle during the Marine Cup Tournament held on the ship. Mr. Shaw used his to put Mrs. Ripple's Watchog asleep so he could enter the room and take another look at the jewel. When the power was restored, Mrs. Ripple and Porter found a shocked Mr. Shaw inside the room, claiming that the Eye of Liepard was nowhere to be found.

After recovering of her fainting, Mrs. Ripple immediately suspected that Mr. Shaw was the thief, so the of the cruise interrogated him, and Mr. Shaw desperately insisted that he was not guilty. With the help of Mrs. Ripple's and , his constant claims of innocence were proven true, due to the real criminal being Teaque, who managed to steal the jewel just before Mr. Shaw entered the room. After Tedesco arrested the thief, Mrs. Ripple came to good terms with him, and he decided not to insist on buying the Eye of Liepard.
